title: E-GRV-0067: no time dilation from the occupancy-gated wake, fail on H2 to H5: past a crowd whose docks wait 16 beats...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0067 in the gravity arena: no time dilation from the occupancy-gated wake, fail on H2 to H5: past a crowd whose docks wait 16 beats (husk ball of radius 2, side 32), the wake reaches every husk column outside the crowd on time (0 of 98, 210, 350, 450 columns late at r = 3 to 6, and 0 at every r out to 22), so the offset has no 1/r (fit a = 0) and the front behind the crowd is not delayed (0 beats at k = 3 to 6): it goes round the crowd at no cost, the D4 mesh having many shortest paths; single docks at depths the crowd shadows are born up to 3 beats late, mean 0.079, 0.042, 0.017, 0.0088 at r = 3 to 6 and 0 from r = 7; the crowd's center column is reached 16 beats late; the proper-time deficit is a fixed offset that never grows (0 at t = 100 and t = 1000), since every born dock beats alike; the uniform control runs 17 times slower everywhere and the charge-flipped crowd is identical at every dock.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
